title: Speaking — Small purchases
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on small purchases.

questions: What part of your work or study do you look forward to?
When do you usually find it easiest to focus?
What would make your workplace or classroom more comfortable?
Do you expect to do something different in future?
What sort of inexpensive things do you buy regularly?
Do you compare prices for everyday items?

part2.topic: Describe a small purchase that turned out to be unusually useful.
part2.closing: and explain what makes it good value.

questions: Why do people sometimes value inexpensive possessions more than costly ones?
How can packaging affect people's expectations of a product?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to small purchases?
